# Guideline Central

> > The world's largest clinical guideline library providing evidence-based medical recommendations and healthcare insights for clinicians.

Guideline Central aggregates clinical practice guidelines from major medical societies including ACC, AHA, USPSTF, ASCO, ASH, NICE, and others. The platform features the InSights Hub for medical news updates, integrated clinical decision support (CDS) tools, EHR compatibility, and CME education resources across specialties including oncology, gastroenterology, and immunization.

## Key Topics

- Clinical practice guidelines
- Evidence-based medicine
- USPSTF recommendations
- Clinical decision support (CDS)
- EHR integration
- InSights Hub medical news
- CME education
- ASH, ASCO, NICE, VA/DoD guidelines
- Oncology guidelines
- Gastroenterology (ACG)
- Immunization schedules (CDC ACIP)
- PubMed integration
- FDA updates
- Healthcare platform
- Guideline search and repository

## Core Platform

- [Guideline Central - The Largest Guideline Library in the World!](https://www.guidelinecentral.com/): Homepage for Guideline Central's clinical guideline library and InSights Hub
- [Medical Guidelines Clearinghouse and Library - Guideline Repository](https://www.guidelinecentral.com/guidelines/): Main guideline repository from ACC, AHA, and other medical societies

## Healthcare InSights & Medical News

- [Evidence-Based Medicine News, Updates & Healthcare InSights](https://www.guidelinecentral.com/insights/): Medical news and updates from ASH, BSH, ACG, VA/DoD, and NICE guidelines

## Clinical Guidelines by Specialty

- [CDC ACIP 2024 Childhood and Adolescent Immunization Schedule Clinical Guideline Summary](https://www.guidelinecentral.com/guideline/1552122/): CDC ACIP 2024 childhood/adolescent immunization schedule guideline
